title: Unlit Campfire Refined Fusion
description: This resource pack is for removing fire flames from icons and in hand models.
body:
### This resource pack is for removing fire flames from icons and in hand models.

Do you...
- Like Fusion 3D items, but dislike its torches?
- Like Refined Torches, but dislike its campfires?
- Like Unlit Campfire, but dislike flamed icons and in-hand flamed models?

I do like them, so i made a kind of patch to mix them up.

![Unlit Campfire Refined Fusion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dde8ff1b5928f2dce4a487b7ccce80b10d2f1184.jpeg)

Requirements (all credits to their developers):
- [Unlit Campfire](https://modrinth.com/mod/unlit-campfire)
- [Refined Torches](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/refined-torches)
- [Fusion 3D Items](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fusion-3d-items)
- [Punchy!](https://modrinth.com/mod/punchy-fpa) (optional)

Loading order is important, from top to bottom, make sure it matches:
1. Unlit Campfire Refined Fusion
2. Refined Torches
3. Fusion 3D Items
4. Punchy!

I tested it on Minecraft 1.21.1 + NeoForge 21.1.232, other versions should work.
